metadata.scope: This is experience evidence, not a source of game facts or universal strategic rules. Screens were read from delayed QuickTime snapshots.

legal_actions: next three combats enemies have 1 HP
records.selected_action: next three combats enemies have 1 HP
records.reasoning: Three low-risk early combats can produce card rewards while preserving HP.
records.prediction: The next three combats will be substantially safer.
records.actual_result: The run displayed a three-combat counter and the first three observed enemies had 1 current HP.

records.reasoning: Both enemies were lethal to one Strike; removing the attacker first prevented its damage.
records.prediction: Both enemies die with no HP loss.
records.actual_result: Combat reward screen appeared with player at 80/80.

records.reasoning: Immediate damage plus card draw was judged useful for the early deck.
records.prediction: Improves early damage without reducing hand quality.

records.reasoning: Efficient block plus draw adds defense without sacrificing consistency.
records.prediction: Adds useful defense for harder future combats.
records.actual_result: Shrug It Off entered the deck.

records.reasoning: Persistent area damage was judged useful against future multi-enemy combats; the HP cost was considered manageable.
records.prediction: Improves sustained damage at a controllable HP cost.
records.actual_result: Combust entered the deck and later dealt visible end-of-turn damage.

records.reasoning: It was initially inferred to be an Elite and player HP was full.
records.prediction: An Elite fight and relic reward would follow.
records.actual_result: A normal 48-HP combat occurred with normal rewards and no relic.
records.discrepancy: Map icon was misclassified from the delayed visual feed.
records.lesson: Do not treat uncertain map-node classification as verified; re-observe or request human confirmation before risk-based path claims.

records.reasoning: Set up persistent damage while reducing incoming 12 damage with 10 Block.
records.prediction: Lose 1 HP to Combust and 2 HP through Block; enemy loses 5 HP at end of turn.
records.actual_result: Player HP changed from 73 to 70 and enemy HP changed from 30 to 25.
